user.title: Connect to TeddyCloud
user.description: Uses your existing Home Assistant MQTT integration. Enter the box certificate common names, not display names.

data.boxes: Toniebox certificate common names (one per line)
data.password: HTTP password (leave blank to keep the saved password)

book.title: Add audiobook
book.description: Use the NFC tag UID; colons and lowercase letters are accepted.

folder.title: Choose a library folder
folder.description: Enter a folder relative to TeddyCloud’s library, for example AudiobookSegments/MyBook. Only existing, valid TAF files can be selected.

files.title: Choose ordered segments
files.description: Selected files are initially ordered by filename. Existing titles are preserved. You can change names and positions later using Edit segment. This replaces the selected book’s segment list.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read TeddyCloud. Check the URL, credentials and library folder.
error.no_tafs: No valid TAF files were found in this folder.
error.invalid_config: The configuration is invalid; use distinct audio IDs and at least one segment per book.
error.select_files: Select at least one TAF file.
error.last_segment: A book must keep at least one segment.
error.confirm_reset: Confirm the possible progress reset before saving.

abort.already_configured: TeddyCloud Audiobooks is already configured. Use Configure on its existing entry.
abort.invalid_config: The configuration is invalid. Verify the files, audio IDs and book details.
abort.last_book: Keep at least one audiobook. To remove the last book, remove the integration instead.

remove_book.title: Remove an audiobook
remove_book.description: This stops managing the tag. It does not delete TAF files or restore the tag’s previous TeddyCloud assignment.

confirm.title: Save configuration
confirm.description: Save {books} audiobook(s) with {segments} segment(s). {resets} book(s) have removed or replaced segments. Existing progress follows the same source/audio ID when possible. If its assigned segment was removed, the checkbox allows resetting that book to segment 1. All active playback timers are discarded when settings reload.

data.allow_reset: Allow progress to reset to segment 1 if its assigned segment was removed
